style.prompt: Design a polished open mic night event poster. Portrait layout, striking midnight-blue and warm cream palette, vintage screen-printed gig poster aesthetic, subtle paper grain, a single illustrated stage microphone in a warm spotlight, small musical accents, strong graphic composition and generous negative space. Clear, beautifully typeset, highly legible lettering is the main focus. Include ONLY these exact words, with centered dots separating the three phrases, arranged in a clear typographic hierarchy: "Open Mic Night · Friday 7pm · The Blue Door". Make Open Mic Night the large headline, Friday 7pm a prominent secondary line, and The Blue Door the venue line. Do not add any other text, dates, logos, or watermarks.
